question: Will the rate of CPI inflation be above 4.1% for the year ending in November 2026? (BLS one-decimal value, i.e. 4.2% or more)
rationale: Blind estimate: Sept 2026 YoY 3.7%, Oct +0.4% m/m, low Nov 2025 base (2.7% YoY after the shutdown gap) gave a central 4.17% with sd 0.18. Locked before reading the price. Check made AFTER the lock (not scored): gasoline fell below $4 in early November and my October unadjusted change was generous, so a careful estimate is nearer 4.0% and about 10-15% for this strike. Lesson added to the checklist in REGOLE.md.
